__comment: Frameless log doors: 2/3 blocks single leaf, 4 blocks double leaf. Eight voxels per block, uneven 30/31-voxel tops beneath a four-block opening.
Doors stay walkable. RoomManager seals every footprint column regardless of cosmetic hinge state. All variants use the same placement, hauling and uninstall pipeline.
description: Rough logs pegged into two frameless leaves. Swing open as dwarves approach, fit a 4-block-wide opening and seal the room for warmth.
